title: HPR Community News February 2024
blurb: Ken Fallon and Dave review February 2024 episodes and listener feedback, and discuss queue policies, site infrastructure, and YouTube publishing.

summary.purpose: Review Hacker Public Radio community shows, listener comments, and administrative updates for February 2024.

keyTakeaways.point: New hosts must select slots in the main queue rather than the reserve queue to ensure proper introduction and prevent queue script breakage.
Large source code blocks will be attached as separate linked files on the server to prevent hidden null characters from breaking XML feeds.
HPR strictly prohibits verbatim LLM and ChatGPT content submissions due to legal ambiguities surrounding international copyright and licensing.
HPR statistics have been migrated to a JSON endpoint that regenerates every 15 minutes to reduce database overhead.

topics.heading: Monthly Episode Reviews and Listener Feedback
points: Reviewed community episodes covering Advent of Code, PC hardware, nautical timekeeping, Raspberry Pi astrophotography, Pi-hole setups, and folk music.
Addressed community comments and technical inquiries across recent and archive episodes.
Highlighted a feed parsing error caused by null characters in CircuitPython show notes.

topics.heading: Queue Management and Technical Infrastructure
points: Clarified policy requiring first-time contributors to submit shows to the main queue rather than the reserve queue.
Reviewed recent bug fixes and proposed a dedicated joint bug review and triage session.
Discussed the new JSON statistics file and invited community contributions to Gitea repository workflows.

topics.heading: Future Initiatives and Community Outreach
points: Proposed an 'Episode 0' introductory show format to be periodically updated for new listeners.
Discussed plans to distribute HPR episodes to YouTube and sought assistance with media generation tools.

nextSteps: Collect listener feedback on content for the proposed Episode 0 show.
Schedule a joint triage session between Ken Fallon and Dave to review and close pending bug tickets.
Explore community tooling options for generating YouTube video assets from audio shows.

actionItems.text: Investigate and fix the profile display bug on generated pages
